training_target_definition: Unchanged recorded motor feedback positions in degrees

input_priority.policy: M23/M16: q1/q2 primary, q3 secondary gain 0.5, q0 gain 0.25; other motors retain their previous per-motor weights. See bend_head_training for penalties.

q_reference_source: Whole-run startup frame, 2026-10-16 16:16:39; before middle collection, NOT an exact middle motor-zero pose
side_motor_mapping: q0-only anchor plus bending correction; negative correction smoothly bounded, positive payout preserved
training_scope: Formal full (thumb) or xy (other fingers), including movement timeouts; ring point_id<2214
fit_limitation: Validation is raw recorded motor feedback, NOT rebased motor-zero control accuracy or hardware tracking. Reference can lie outside sampled poses; neutral subtraction does not calibrate physical zero. No robot test or closed-loop q control performed. Ring uses four same-session targets from ring_data, whereas the current polynomial uses older extensor/flexor data.

training.details: bend_head_training; M2/M9/M24 training fields and validation retained

control_policy_validation_note: M23/M16 raw-feedback validation recomputed; other estimates inherited. Outer folds do not enter scaling, gradients or epoch selection. Architecture exploration was done before this evaluation; this is not a fully nested architecture-search accuracy estimate or hardware validation.

extensor_structure.activation: half softplus; half tanh; bounded negative hidden tails
extensor_structure.guarantee: Monotonic payout in q1/q2/q3. No correct OOD amplitude or hardware accuracy guarantee.

source_training.side_head_architecture: q0 and bending:4→W→W→1 with disjoint input masks; per-motor activations in side_structure
source_training.note: Per-side training is in side_training; extensor/flexor retain earlier training fields.

preserved_outputs.note: Their neural weights, scales, side policy and reference are unchanged.

extensor_training.original_boundary_definition: q1 and q2 both >= their training-fold 80th percentiles
extensor_training.target_definition: Unchanged recorded motor feedback positions in degrees
extensor_training.selection: Median inner-selected epochs from five pose folds; final fit on all original rows

flexor_structure.output_activation: identity then fixed sign -1, before output de-standardization
flexor_structure.guarantee: At fixed other inputs, increasing q1/q2/q3 never increases M2 motor position (never reduces winding). No minimum winding slope or OOD accuracy guarantee.

flexor_training.selection: Median inner-selected epochs from five outer pose folds; final fit on original rows
flexor_training.target_definition: Unchanged recorded motor feedback positions in degrees

side_structure.guarantee: Signed q0 monotonicity follows motor_directions, including after the side policy. Bending correction is independent of q0. No amplitude or hardware tracking guarantee.

9.selection: Median inner-selected epochs from five outer pose folds; final fit on original rows
9.target_definition: Unchanged recorded motor feedback positions in degrees

24.selection: Median inner-selected epochs from five outer pose folds; final fit on original rows
24.target_definition: Unchanged recorded motor feedback positions in degrees

middle_structure_note: M23/M16 use monotonic Softplus+tanh hidden units with bounded negative tails. M23 q1/q2/q3 payout is monotonic; M16 q1/q2 winding is monotonic with weak, unconstrained q3 coupling. M2/M9/M24 weights and control policy unchanged.

23.original_boundary_definition: q1 and q2 both >= their training-fold 80th percentiles
23.target_definition: Unchanged recorded motor feedback positions in degrees
23.selection: Median inner-selected epochs from five pose folds; final fit on all original rows

16.selection: Median inner-selected epochs from five pose folds; final fit on all original rows

shallow_flexor_structure.hidden_activation: half softplus; half tanh, both monotonic; bounded negative hidden tails
shallow_flexor_structure.q3_constraint: Soft weight penalty only; not forced to the deep-flexor q3 direction
shallow_flexor_structure.guarantee: Monotonic winding in q1/q2 only. No OOD amplitude or q3 derivative guarantee.
